details.rekordbox: set, rekordbox push, usb and pull drive rekordbox's own menus on macOS and are CLI only; sync (MCP: djlib_import_rekordbox_analysis) reads its analysis files in the background. The USB export is verified from the stick's device library (export.pdb) against each file's SHA-256
details.web_sources: YouTube and SoundCloud search (djlib_find_sources) and MP3 downloads of unverified source quality
details.set_links: YouTube and SoundCloud set descriptions or chapters become the tracklist; listener comments near each ID are hints, not identifications
details.set_identification: djlib identify LINK (MCP: djlib_identify_set) reads a YouTube or SoundCloud set's description, chapters and comments, listens to it with song recognition (Shazam, unofficial; or licensed AudD or ACRCloud) and merges one timestamped tracklist with a status and evidence per track; djlib set LINK uses it when the published tracklist is missing, has IDs or names too few songs for the set's length
details.shazam_history: djlib set shazam (MCP: djlib_shazam_history lists them) reads the songs the user Shazamed: this Mac's history, an iPhone backup, a CSV or Apple Music

/capabilities.identity_method: exact artist/title/version labels from tags or file names, hash-checked; the user's own files are never matched by sound
/capabilities.delivery_default: rekordbox: djlib set or rekordbox push/usb from the CLI on macOS; working-copy deliveries: small pilot before bulk, native steps by the operator
/capabilities.stage: experimental alpha; consult docs/STATUS.md for app/provider test evidence
